Traveling with Apple gear usually means lugging around a mess of charging cables and wall adapters. The RORRY Flow power bank is designed to solve that problem by integrating everything you need into one compact battery. It features built-in wall prongs, an integrated USB-C charging cable, and a magnetic charger specifically for Apple Watch. This is exactly the kind of accessory I love to take on vacation, as it handles everything from travel charging to overnight top-ups.

MagSafe Monday: Every Monday, Bradley Chambers rounds up the latest and greatest MagSafe and wireless charging accessories to help you get the most out of your wireless charging-enabled Apple devices.

Designed for travel

The RORRY Flow power bank has foldable wall prongs built into the back, so you don't need to bring a separate wall charger to recharge the bank itself—just plug it directly into a wall outlet at your hotel or beachside rental. It also comes with a built-in USB-C cable (a design touch I absolutely love!), so you can charge your iPhone, iPad, Kindle, Switch, and more without bringing any extra cables along.

Although I usually focus on iPhone MagSafe features in this column, this power bank includes a built-in 5W magnetic charger dedicated to Apple Watch. Just place your Apple Watch on the power bank to top it up easily—it's both convenient and practical. It holds the watch securely and charges it, so there's no need to carry the original charger.

With a 10,000 mAh capacity, this power bank has more than enough juice to keep your iPhone and Apple Watch powered through long travel days. For me, the most useful feature is the 40W output via USB-C. That's enough to top up a MacBook Air (with the lid closed) in an emergency.

RORRY Flow power bank wrap-up

If you're looking to slim down the gear in your travel bag for your Apple devices, the RORRY Flow power bank is a solid pick. With a sleek, compact design, it replaces your wall charger, Apple Watch charging cable, and USB-C cable all at once, making it easy to slip into a bag or pocket.

You can buy the RORRY Flow portable charger directly from the RORRY website or on Amazon.
